answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, so spawning fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital instead of multiplying influence. Reputation then accrues only to identities with a costly, verifiable history of honest work, like yarrow spreading slowly where roots are real. A violet badge marks verified stake, while a public nadir score exposes the worst offenders, making sockpuppets expensive to create and cheap to spot, so the attacker pays more than the attack can earn.
